sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Small Parcel Sorting and Direct-Injection Linehaul

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common-law corporate statutes, local customary law, and Compact of Free Association framework)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (not a BIT)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) — trade in goods protocol
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands, Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Business Corporations Act, Division 10 (Beneficial Ownership Records), RMI Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport (biographical page) of each director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or licensed notary public in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization via RMI Embassy/Honorary Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (utility bill or bank statement not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or regulated financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from a regulated bank confirming business relationship and due diligence standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney / Registered Agent Authorization executed by each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Director or UBO before a notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against RMI Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated lists, US OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, and applicable regional sanctions lists; enhanced due diligence required for any politically exposed person (PEP), family members, and close associates.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry — administered by the Registrar of Corporations within the Ministry of Finance; filing effected exclusively through licensed resident registered agents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in English or a Latin-alphabet transliteration; non-Latin source names require a standard romanized transliteration. Name must include a mandatory suffix: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an abbreviation thereof. No dual-script name is required.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant (through its registered agent) may request reconsideration from the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days, providing legal arguments and evidence of non-conflict; if reconsideration fails, a formal written administrative appeal must be lodged with the Registrar within 30 days of the rejection notice; the decision is reviewable by the Minister of Finance and ultimately the High Court.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office cannot satisfy the statutory registered office requirement, which must be a physical street address in the Marshall Islands capable of receiving service of process and open during business hours. A virtual or business address may be used as a supplementary mailing address. No local physical office is required for the parcel consolidation hub's business conducted outside the Republic.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <5% annual probability of unannounced physical site inspection for a non-resident entity with no external operations in the RMI); registered agents and regulated service providers are subject to higher-frequency AML/CFT compliance monitoring and periodic inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and priority search fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent (pass-through of Registrar of Corporations fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and statutory tariff schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for Business Corporation (no minimum authorized capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident business corporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT know-your-client and UBO verification package (screening, risk assessment, consent filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for CDD and sanctions screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization, courier dispatch of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, apostille authority, and courier service (reimbursable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Actual costs based on relevant government schedules and courier tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of articles of incorporation and ancillary corporate governance documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee legal services on prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended; sections governing Articles of Incorporation (Section 26), Registered Office and Registered Agent (Section 31), Board of Directors (Section 40), and Officers (Section 47).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Division of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) together with the Registered Agent Acceptance form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for the Marshall Islands Business Corporation; shares may be with par value or no par value, no escrow account or capital deposit mandate applies, and capital is determined solely by the incorporators and recorded in the Articles.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription agreement of the initial shareholders for the authorized common shares is approved and such shares are hereby issued in accordance with the Articles of Incorporation. RESOLVED, that the registered office at [address], Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, together with the appointed registered agent, is adopted as the corporation’s statutory registered office and agent for service of process. RESOLVED, that [President name] is appointed President, [Secretary name] is appointed Secretary, and [Treasurer name] is appointed Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual general meeting. RESOLVED, that the corporate banking relationship is authorized and that the Officers are directed to complete all filings required for the parcel consolidation hub operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, online application portal and counter service at the Office of the Attorney General.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request using the official corporate name search window; ensure the proposed name is distinguishable from existing entities and that the words 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Ltd.' are included. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name availability from the Registrar
Proof of payment of name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 10 business days, or amend the requested name and re-submit the reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate legal counsel and notarization authority where the incorporators are located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, purpose, authorized shares, registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, registered agent details, and mailing address. The incorporator or incorporators must execute the document before a notary public or equivalent witnessed signature authority. For foreign incorporators, the signature may be notarized overseas and legalized or apostilled if required by the Registry.
required_dossiers: Notarized or apostilled incorporation directive (if outside RMI)
Registered agent consent form duly executed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles contain technical defects, the Registrar will issue a letter of query; counsel may file a corrected set of Articles and pay a re-submission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Articles and Payment of Incorporation Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, RMI.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the formal Articles of Incorporation together with the registered agent consent and the undertaking of the registered office. Make payment of the prescribed incorporation filing fee via wire transfer, bank draft, or approved online facility. Request and receive a stamped filing copy from the Registry.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of incorporation filing fee
Any special conditions approved by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, correct the named deficiencies, resubmit within 15 business days, and request expedited processing upon payment of the expedited fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation. Verify that the corporation’s name, number, date of incorporation, and authorized share capital appear correctly. Retrieve the certified copy, maintain it in the corporate minute book, and update the statutory records.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains errors, apply for a Certificate of Correction with a supporting affidavit and the original certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Registered Agent Record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent maintaining a physical address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent must confirm acceptance of service of process and record the registered office street address and mailing address in the corporate register. The agent files the Registered Agent Consent with the Registrar, or confirms the appointment as indicated in the Articles.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns, appoint a new agent and file a Statement of Change of Registered Agent or Registered Office with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and corporate minutes; no separate state filing required under the Business Corporations Act.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporators or initial board adopt organizational resolutions to approve share subscription, appoint directors and officers, open a corporate bank account, and adopt the corporate seal, if any. Record the resolutions in the minute book and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: Corporate minute book and stock transfer ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or officer resigns or is disqualified, the board passes a replacement resolution and executes an updated officer consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Filings and Good Standing Maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the annual filing and pay the annual franchise or corporate tax, if applicable, before the anniversary date. Ensure all corporate records are kept at the registered agent’s office or another location permitted by the Act and that the registered agent remains current.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered agent consent for the current year
Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporation is administratively dissolved for non-filing or non-payment, apply for reinstatement with the Registrar, file all overdue declarations, and pay the reinstatement fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment and Trade Division, Ministry of Commerce and Enterprise, in conjunction with the Business License Authority of the Majuro Atoll Local Government.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (Parcel Consolidation Hub and Transportation Support Services) and Local Business License (Category: Warehousing and Cargo Handling)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration and Environmental Due Diligence Form; Full EIA Report is required only if the project expands to significant parcel volume, imports fuel for linehaul vehicles above 500 kWh equivalent, or generates hazardous waste streams.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No discharge of untreated wastewater or leachate to land or lagoon; stormwater runoff must meet EPA sediment and petroleum hydrocarbon limits; volatile organic compound emissions from packaging materials and cleaning solvents must comply with EPA ambient air quality standards; waste handling must segregate recyclables and authorize a licensed waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Majuro Fire Department covering the sorting facility and office area; annual structural load inspection certificate for any mezzanine racks and conveyor support systems; occupational hygiene clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services verifying safe ventilation, noise levels, and workstation ergonomics.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance – Revenue and Taxation Division; corporate registry: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Trade
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations (BCs) are not subject to RMI income tax on foreign-source income and are not issued a TIN as a tax prerequisite. The BC applies for incorporation through the RMI Registrar of Corporations and receives a BCA registration number used as the entity identifier. If the BC conducts any on-island business or requires a local business license, it applies to the Business License Office for a Business License number; otherwise no separate tax ID is procured.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No entity-classification or hybrid mismatch election exists under RMI domestic tax law. A non-resident BC maintains tax-exempt treatment by limiting activities to offshore/foreign-source business; engaging in RMI-source business may trigger local licensing and potentially local tax obligations. No check-the-box election is available because RMI imposes no central corporate income tax regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST/sales tax; RMI imposes customs import duties on inbound goods only.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT/GST registration threshold exists; import duty is assessed per transaction at customs clearance, not on the basis of economic turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate is in force. RMI Customs processes electronic export/import declarations; there is no digital stamping or government clearance of invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – exports of goods and offshore services from a non-resident BC are outside the scope of RMI indirect tax because no VAT/GST is levied. No export zero-rating claim is required or available, and there is no input VAT refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (e-filed with RMI Customs)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment confirmation (for routed export proceeds)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating clawback applies in the absence of a VAT system. Customs authorities may audit export declarations and assess uncollected import duty, penalties, and interest on false declarations; intentionally fraudulent export or duty-exemption misrepresentation can attract seizure of goods, monetary penalties, and criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (no central bank is established; the RMI uses the U.S. dollar as legal tender)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI has no domestic currency and maintains no exchange-control apparatus. USD is fully convertible and freely transferable for both current-account transactions (trade settlements, logistics fees, carrier payments) and capital-account transactions (equity injections, shareholder loans, dividend remittances, liquidation proceeds). There are no statutory approvals, taxes, or waiting periods on profit repatriation; the only practical hurdles are bank-level KYC/AML, correspondent-bank due diligence, and the financial-statement evidence required to distinguish genuine treasury flows from money laundering.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The RMI imposes no mandatory surrender of export receipts, no prescribed conversion ratio, and no statutory timeline for converting foreign currency into USD. Export-related receivables may be retained indefinitely in a licensed bank as USD deposits or freely converted through the banking system; a mandatory conversion ratio of 0% applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current account) for trade settlements and local clearing
Capital Escrow Account (restricted USD account for inbound shareholder injections)
Operational Account (USD current account) with U.S. correspondent clearing access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for supplemental disbursement routing; Low as a primary treasury relationship. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Airwallex are not licensed to take deposits or provide payment services inside the RMI Banking Act 1987 framework. They may lawfully be used only as front-end aggregation, FX conversion, and disbursement engines whose underlying settlement is ultimately cleared through a licensed RMI bank or a U.S. correspondent bank; any platform that holds and re-transmits client funds in a manner constituting deposit-taking within RMI could require a banking license. Accordingly, the EMI rail is acceptable for high-velocity small-parcel collections and linehaul injections, but capital escrow and statutory books must remain with a licensed banking institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no RMI statute requiring every director to appear physically before a bank. In practice, however, licensed banks treat non-resident Business Corporations with a registered-agent address as enhanced-risk, and the on-boarding policy of Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam normally requires at least one director or authorized signatory, and in some cases the ultimate beneficial owner, to complete an in-person interview at the bank's Majuro office or an approved correspondent-bank branch in Guam. Remote opening is permissible only when the company has an existing prime banking relationship, the corporate dossier is notarized and apostilled, certified passport copies and a board resolution are supplied, and a live video interview is completed with the bank's compliance officer. A fully virtual on-boarding without any physical contact is generally not available for the escrow account class.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident RMI Business Corporation with a registered-agent address, no staffed office in Majuro, and tax-exempt/non-resident status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; Articles of Incorporation; registered-agent agreement; board resolution authorizing the account; shareholder register with UBO disclosure; source-of-wealth declaration; financial statements or opening net-worth evidence; lease or third-party logistics agreement demonstrating an operational parcel-consolidation site.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border e-commerce hub transacting with numerous merchants, forwarders, and last-mile carriers, creating a high-volume low-value wire profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed transaction-flow diagram from parcel intake to direct-injection linehaul; counterparty KYC files and merchant underwriting standards; sanctions/PEP screening logs; executed logistics and carrier agreements; sample commercial invoices; a written transaction-monitoring model demonstrating that wire usage matches the stated trade cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital injection into an escrow account before commensurate commercial activity has commenced.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder contribution agreement; source-of-funds evidence from the originating bank or audited financial statements; board minutes approving the capital plan; repayment and lock-up undertaking; undertaking to restrict disbursements to verified trade settlement; monthly reconciliation reports to the account officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Profit remittance or dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders shortly after revenue accumulation in an offshore tax-exempt entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or reviewed financial statements; allocation and distribution ledger; board resolution declaring the dividend; RMI non-resident/tax-exempt status certificate; transfer-pricing policy covering intercompany logistics and consolidation fees; cash-flow forecast confirming the remittance does not derive from unsubstantiated third-party pass-through payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All shareholder capital, director loans, and intercompany funding must be remitted in USD by SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire/CHIPS through a U.S. correspondent) explicitly naming the RMI corporate account as beneficiary. Recommended message field 70 purpose text is 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' and, where the correspondent bank maps ISO 20022 purpose codes, use 'CAPIT' for a capital investment or 'EQUIT' for equity injection. The receiving bank will verify the remitter against sanctions lists, will require a board resolution and updated register of shareholders to be presented before credit is confirmed, and will normally place funds into the Capital Escrow Account. Any foreign-currency capital must be converted into USD through the receiving bank or its correspondent at the prevailing spot rate; no central-bank confirmation is necessary because the RMI has no exchange-control regime.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to suppliers, linehaul carriers, and overseas consolidation partners should be executed via SWIFT MT103 for open-account disbursements and via irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP600) where the seller requires bank-assured payment. Documentary LC settlements will be routed through the issuing bank's U.S. correspondent using MT103/MT202 COV, with commercial invoices, packing lists, air waybills, and proof-of-delivery certificates constituting the presentation package. On-island carrier payments and small parcel reimbursements may be cleared through the local clearing rail of Bank of Marshall Islands, which settles in USD domestically without SWIFT charges; for Airwallex or digital rails, funds are prefunded from the licensed RMI account and then disbursed through the EMI's local payment network to overseas beneficiaries.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/foreign-currency FX forward contracts with maturity dates matched to confirmed commercial cash flows, entered into with a licensed international bank under an approved ISDA/CSA, and used solely to hedge settlement risk.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on restricted currencies, particularly USD/CNH and USD/PHP, executed with an authorized dealer under a Board-approved ISDA 2002 Master Agreement for bona fide trade exposure and subject to an internal pro-hedging policy.

Cross-currency swaps between USD and freely convertible operating currencies used to transform trade-financing liabilities or match long-term intercompany funding, provided the notional and interest payment dates correspond to actual or highly probable underlying exposures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report and Franchise Tax Payment (Business Corporations Act, Section 108)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted through the licensed RMI registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before November 30 of each calendar year (fixed statutory date, not the incorporation anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$20 per month or fraction thereof; failure to file for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off or revocation of the articles of incorporation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Notification (Economic Substance Regulations 2019, as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Economic Substance Unit, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 12 months after the end of the entity's accounting reporting period; filing cycle coordinated with the registered agent and aligned to the November 30 annual report cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to US$5,000 for non-filing or submission of false information; continued default may result in administrative strike-off and referral to the RMI tax authorities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation (annual renewal of RMI agent mandate and office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent (private sector capacity; registered office evidence maintained for inspection by the Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous statutory obligation; annual renewal and fee settlement aligned with the November 30 filing cycle to maintain good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of the registered agent or registered office causes loss of good standing, unavailability of the Certificate of Good Standing, and may lead to administrative involuntary dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit applies to a non-resident, non-public RMI Business Corporation; no financial statements are filed with the Registrar. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only for stock-exchange-listed issuers, licensed banks, insurance or reinsurance entities, or where the articles, bylaws, shareholders' resolution, or a creditor instrument expressly requires an audited financial statement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The RMI Business Corporations Act prescribes no local statutory GAAP; books may be kept in any currency and at any location and must reasonably reflect transactions and financial position. IFRS or US GAAP is adopted at management's election for any voluntary or lender-required certified audit; underlying records must be maintained in English or convertible into English.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone UBO filing is submitted to the Registrar; the licensed RMI registered agent acts as Disclosure Officer and must hold a current Register of Beneficial Ownership at the RMI registered office. The corporation must notify the agent of any shareholding or UBO change within 30 days, and annually execute a management declaration confirming the UBO register concurrently with the annual report cycle. The register is produced to the Registrar, the Financial Intelligence Unit, or other competent authorities on lawful demand.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Ownership (held by the RMI licensed Registered Agent as Disclosure Officer)
Minute Book of members' and directors' meetings and written resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500 - US$1,500 per annum (typical licensed RMI registered agent and registered office service fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary certified audit (IFRS or US GAAP) if required by shareholders or lenders: approximately US$3,000 - US$8,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) levies no corporate income tax on a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC) that is not carrying on a trade or business within the RMI; on-island domestic activity would subject the RMI-source income to the Income Tax Act 1989.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption (0% effective rate): exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding, interest/royalty withholding, and any annual franchise tax; no payroll or social security charge for non-resident corporations; the only recurring charge is a nominal annual government registry fee (USD 100 to USD 2,500 depending on authorized capital).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A — No RMI corporate income tax return form exists for a Non-Resident Business Corporation; there is no Tax Office registration and no CIT filing obligation. The only mandatory periodic filing is the Section 104 Corporate Annual Report submitted in the RMI Corporate Registry e-portal through the licensed RMI Registered Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report and the annual government fee are due on or before 31 December of each calendar year (or on the anniversary date as directed by the Registered Agent under the Business Corporation Act); a corporation delinquent for one year is administratively dissolved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Corporate name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name of the Business Corporation and the full RMI Corporate Registry registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the name and number exactly as they appear on the registration certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name of the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and the full street address of the registered office in Majuro.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident corporation must maintain a local registered agent and a physical registered office; a P.O. Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, and nationalities of each director and officer in office on the due date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Director and officer addresses outside the RMI are permissible; no RMI residency or licence requirement applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized shares, par value, issued and outstanding share counts, and aggregate consideration received.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If shares are partly paid, state unpaid capital; the RMI imposes no minimum paid-in capital requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recertification that the corporation is not engaged in trade or business within the RMI and has derived no RMI-source income during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard attestation box; knowingly false statements expose the signatory to criminal penalties under the Business Corporation Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of the annual registry fee from the prevailing government fee schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payable through the registered agent; this fee is not a tax and does not create any income tax reporting obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Report incurs a late fee of USD 100 and may trigger a resignation notice from the registered agent; a corporation delinquent for one year is administratively dissolved by the Registrar under BCA s.105. Reinstatement requires payment of all accrued annual fees plus a reinstatement fee. Willfully false statements in the Annual Report constitute a misdemeanor punishable by a fine up to USD 5,000 and/or imprisonment up to one year.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — The RMI imposes no withholding tax on cash or stock dividends paid by a Non-Resident Business Corporation, irrespective of the shareholder's country of residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double-taxation agreement (DTA) network exists: the RMI has no income tax treaties and does not issue tax-residency certificates (TRCs) because no income tax is imposed. To evidence the exemption to a foreign revenue authority, the shareholder should obtain from the RMI registered agent (i) a certified copy of the filed Annual Report confirming non-resident status and (ii) a corporate-resolutions certificate confirming the dividend declaration and source. Treaty relief is therefore not applicable; the RMI's only international instruments are Tax Information Exchange Agreements focused on transparency and exchange of information.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate is 0% on outbound royalties and 0% on interest paid to non-residents; no treaty rates are available because no DTA is in force. RMI-source characterization arises only where the payer is engaged in RMI domestic business, which a Non-Resident Business Corporation must scrupulously avoid.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — the RMI has no domestic transfer-pricing legislation, no OECD-aligned Local File or Master File obligations, no country-by-country reporting threshold, and no arm's-length documentation requirement (threshold legally nil in USD).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has not yet codified a comprehensive Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to the BVI or Cayman Islands. However, the EU Council has placed the RMI under Annex II (grey-list) monitoring and the RMI has committed at a high political level to introduce substance requirements for non-resident corporations and maritime entities by the agreed reform deadline. For the parcel-consolidation and linehaul business, the substantive standard is that the entity must perform genuine commercial functions: contract negotiation, risk assumption, real billing operations, and complete financial records maintained in a physical office. A letterbox arrangement directly invites EU black-listing, APG/FATF enhanced scrutiny, correspondent-bank de-risking, and denial of transparency-related cooperation benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Non-Resident Business Corporation actually performing on-island trade or business in the RMI — such as local last-mile delivery, warehouse operations in Majuro, or local payroll — while continuing to claim the non-resident exempt declaration, and failing to register for and pay RMI income tax and the business-licence fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Income Tax Act 1989: assessment of corporate income tax on RMI-source income, statutory interest on overdue tax, a penalty of up to 100% of the additional tax assessed for wilful default, revocation of the registered agent's standing, and administrative strike-off of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the exempt-status declaration while knowingly or recklessly disregarding on-island activity are personally liable for the unpaid corporate tax as responsible officers and may be subjected to civil restitution; conviction for filing a false declaration is punishable by imprisonment up to three years, disqualification from holding RMI directorships, and the RMI High Court may impose a travel ban pending trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / absence of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the RMI corporation solely as a booking or conduit vehicle for parcel-consolidation linehaul revenue without an actually administered registered-agent relationship, without director and officer judgement over contracts, and without reliable accounting records — i.e., a letterbox entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution under the Business Corporation Act for failure to maintain a registered agent or to file the Annual Report; placement of the RMI on the EU Annex I black list with defensive tax measures applied by EU Member States; APG/FATF enhanced follow-up; and automatic termination of the corporate bank relationship by AML-constrained correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors cannot shelter behind the corporate veil where the company is an instrumentality of fraud: the RMI High Court will pierce the veil in fraudulent-conveyance or intermingled-assets cases, imposing civil restitution and equitable compensation; directors engaged in sham invoicing may be extradited on fraud or forgery charges with a travel ban and preventive arrest possible.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT breaches (Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2002)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Handling parcel-settlement flows, cash collections, or Airwallex and local-clearing deposits without customer due-diligence files, beneficial-ownership identification, or transaction monitoring; failing to file a Suspicious Transaction Report with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; or tipping off a customer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering is punishable by a fine up to USD 100,000 and imprisonment up to five years; STR failure and tipping-off offences carry statutory maximum fines of USD 10,000 and imprisonment up to two years; the Financial Intelligence Unit may additionally impose administrative monetary penalties and prohibit the entity from maintaining an account in the RMI banking system.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior management and the designated compliance officer are personally criminally liable for AML failures; directors who knowingly move illicit settlement funds face seizure of personal assets, civil forfeiture proceedings, a statutory travel ban pending investigation, and imprisonment up to five years; the corporate veil is displaced to the extent the legal-entity structure was used as a facade.
